source: LibRaw 0.22.1 A7C II built-in cam_xyz coefficients
derivation: Normalize rows of cam_xyz * sRGB_to_XYZ, invert, then convert sRGB to XYZ D65; matches LibRaw cam_xyz_coeff direction.
white_adaptation: Bradford D65 to ACES white xy 0.32168 0.33767
limitations: Single built-in matrix; not a fitted dual-illuminant DCP or calibrated Sony to Ricoh match.
